scope: Recorded clinical study settings; no participant-level records or model checkpoints

phase_selection.primary_coordinate_processing: Savitzky-Golay window 5, polynomial order 2, then int16 quantization
phase_selection.f04_temporal_sensitivity: Native T01; no second Savitzky-Golay pass
phase_selection.alternating_extrema: Keep the strongest extremum in consecutive same-type runs
phase_selection.pairing: Each ED to minimum following ES before next ED
phase_selection.ef_evaluation: Unfiltered metric Teichholz volumes; mean of valid cycle EF per video, then equal-video mean per examination

bootstrap.scope: Separate families per metric, variant and sensitivity, not a global multiplicity claim
